data.one_liner: Synchronous and asynchronous phone number formatting and parsing in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Wraps native libphonenumber libraries (libphonenumber and PhoneNumberKit) to provide formatting, parsing, and real-time masking for phone numbers. It preloads region masks during initialization to allow synchronous number formatting.
use_when: You need to format and validate international phone numbers in forms or text fields.
You require synchronous phone number formatting to avoid UI jank during typing.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose text masking library not specifically meant for phone numbers.
strengths: Supports synchronous formatting using preloaded masks.
Provides a TextField input formatter for real-time validation and masking.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Web, and macOS.
weaknesses: Requires an explicit `init()` call prior to use or synchronous formatting will fail.
data.setup_notes: Must call await init() before formatting phone numbers or using text formatters.
